description.value: Panago is a BC-based pizza chain with this North Vancouver outpost located in Northwood Village near the first exit off the Second Narrows Bridge on Dollarton Highway, making it a convenient stop for cyclists riding the Dollarton corridor toward Deep Cove or Indian River. The menu features gourmet-inspired pizzas built with fresh-daily dough, antibiotic-free proteins, and organic tomato sauce, alongside salads, wings, and desserts. Vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-smart options are available.
